name: Validating case update.
description: Validating whether the case has been assigned to Paul Moyer and Case Triage_4.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM customer_case c
JOIN contact ct ON c.contact_id = ct.contact_id
JOIN user u ON ct.portal_user_id = u.user_id
JOIN user p ON c.assigned_to = p.user_id
JOIN user_group g ON c.assignment_group_id = g.group_id
WHERE u.first_name = 'Jermaine'
  AND u.last_name = 'Hall'
  AND c.state = 'in_progress'
  AND p.first_name = 'Paul'
  AND p.last_name = 'Moyer'
  AND g.name = 'Case Triage_4';

name: Validating group membership.
description: Validating whether Paul Moyer is assigned to Case Triage_4.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM user_group_member ugm
JOIN user u ON ugm.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN user_group g ON ugm.group_id = g.group_id
WHERE u.first_name = 'Paul'
  AND u.last_name = 'Moyer'
  AND g.name = 'Case Triage_4';

name: Validating report notification status.
description: Validating whether an report notification was successfully sent to Jermaine Hall.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM notification n
JOIN customer_case c ON n.case_id = c.case_id
JOIN contact ct ON c.contact_id = ct.contact_id
JOIN user u ON ct.portal_user_id = u.user_id
JOIN user p ON c.assigned_to = p.user_id
JOIN user_group g ON c.assignment_group_id = g.group_id
WHERE u.first_name = 'Jermaine'
  AND u.last_name = 'Hall'
  AND n.email = u.email
  AND c.state = 'in_progress'
  AND p.first_name = 'Paul'
  AND p.last_name = 'Moyer'
  AND g.name = 'Case Triage_4'
  AND n.type = 'report'
  AND n.status = 'success';
